issues.description: The problem's UML and description indicate messageOnFeed() is a public abstract method of Animal (UML shows '+' visibility), but the solution declares messageOnFeed() as protected abstract. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the expected access level and the intended API of Animal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method signature in Animal public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) in the solution (and instruct students to declare it public) so it matches the UML and the intended public API.
